user.title: Connect DeepL
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant signs in to DeepL.

menu_option_descriptions.api_key: Full feature set: text, documents, structured data and the usage sensors. Works with free (`:fx`) and Pro keys.
menu_option_descriptions.oauth: No key to copy: you log in at DeepL. Translates text and structured data only, without usage sensors or documents. Experimental.

api_key.title: Connect DeepL with an API key
api_key.description: Create an API key in your DeepL account under *Account > Keys and limits*. Keys of the free plan end in `:fx`; free and Pro keys both work.

data_description.api_key: The authentication key of your DeepL API plan.
data_description.default_target_language: Used whenever a service call does not name a target language. Preselected with the language of this Home Assistant server.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the DeepL API key
reauth_confirm.description: DeepL rejected the API key of {account}. Enter a valid key to continue.

reauth_oauth.title: Sign in to DeepL again
reauth_oauth.description: DeepL no longer accepts the sign-in of {account}. Select Submit to log in again.

error.cannot_connect: DeepL could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This DeepL account is already set up.
abort.oauth_unsupported: The DeepL sign-in could not be prepared: {error}
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant needs an address that DeepL's login page can send you back to. Set up the external URL or Home Assistant Cloud, or enable My Home Assistant. [Learn more]({docs_url})
abort.translation_failed: You signed in, but a test translation failed, so the account was not added: {error}
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Creating the DeepL login address took too long.
abort.oauth_error: DeepL's answer to the sign-in could not be understood.
abort.oauth2_timeout: DeepL did not answer the sign-in in time.
abort.oauth_timeout: DeepL did not answer the sign-in in time.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: DeepL did not allow the sign-in: {error}
abort.cannot_connect: DeepL could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.

data_description.default_target_language: Used whenever a service call does not name a target language.
data_description.update_interval: How often the character quota is read, in minutes. Reading it does not use up any quota.
data_description.cache_size: Number of translations kept in memory so identical texts are not billed twice. Set 0 to turn the cache off.
data_description.discover_translator: Offer the installed companion under Devices & services (HA 2023.7+). Disable on every DeepL account to stop suggestions. Manual setup remains available.

translate_text.name: Translate text
translate_text.description: Translates one or more texts with DeepL and returns the result.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text to translate. Use a list to translate several texts in one request.

target_language.name: Target language
target_language.description: Language to translate into. Defaults to the one chosen for the integration.

source_language.name: Source language
source_language.description: Language of the text. Leave empty to let DeepL detect it.

formality.name: Formality
formality.description: Formal or informal wording, for languages that support it. The prefer options fall back silently for other languages.

context.name: Context
context.description: Additional context that improves the translation without being translated or billed.

glossary_id.name: Glossary ID
glossary_id.description: ID of a DeepL glossary to apply. Requires the source language.

tag_handling.name: Tag handling
tag_handling.description: Set to xml or html when the text contains markup that has to survive the translation.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The DeepL account to use. Only needed when several are set up.

translate_document.name: Translate document
translate_document.description: Translates a file (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, HTML, text and more) and stores the result.

input_file.name: Input file
input_file.description: Path of the file to translate. Relative paths start in the configuration folder.

output_file.name: Output file
output_file.description: Where to store the translation. Defaults to the input name with the target language added, for example report.de.docx.

target_language.name: Target language
target_language.description: Language to translate into. Defaults to the one chosen for the integration.

source_language.name: Source language
source_language.description: Language of the document. Leave empty to let DeepL detect it.

formality.name: Formality
formality.description: Formal or informal wording, for languages that support it.

glossary_id.name: Glossary ID
glossary_id.description: ID of a DeepL glossary to apply. Requires the source language.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for DeepL to finish, in seconds.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The DeepL account to use. Only needed when several are set up.

translate_structure.name: Translate structure
translate_structure.description: Translates only the text values of JSON or YAML data and keeps its structure. Files keep their exact layout, including indentation, key order, quoting and comments; keys are never translated.

data.name: Data
data.description: Structured data to translate. Use this or an input file.

input_file.name: Input file
input_file.description: A JSON or YAML file to translate. Relative paths start in the configuration folder.

output_file.name: Output file
output_file.description: Where to store the translated file. Defaults to the input name with the target language added, for example en.de.json.

format.name: Format
format.description: File format. Auto guesses it from the file extension.

only_keys.name: Only keys
only_keys.description: Translate only values that belong to these keys, for example name, title and message. Recommended for configuration files, where most values are technical.

ignore_keys.name: Ignore keys
ignore_keys.description: Never translate values that belong to these keys.

skip_technical_values.name: Skip technical values
skip_technical_values.description: Leave URLs, entity IDs, icons, colors, version numbers and similar identifiers alone.

protect_placeholders.name: Protect placeholders
protect_placeholders.description: Keep placeholders such as {name}, %s and {{ template }} unchanged.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: List the texts that would be translated and their character count without contacting DeepL or writing anything.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

target_language.name: Target language
target_language.description: Language to translate into. Defaults to the one chosen for the integration.

source_language.name: Source language
source_language.description: Language of the texts. Leave empty to let DeepL detect it.

formality.name: Formality
formality.description: Formal or informal wording, for languages that support it.

context.name: Context
context.description: Additional context that improves the translation without being translated or billed.

glossary_id.name: Glossary ID
glossary_id.description: ID of a DeepL glossary to apply. Requires the source language.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The DeepL account to use. Only needed when several are set up.

get_languages.name: Get languages
get_languages.description: Lists the languages DeepL can translate from or into.

type.name: Type
type.description: Whether to list target or source languages.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The DeepL account to use. Only needed when several are set up.
